conflicts.permit: información sobre los productos de Subsplash que posee, tal como sus números de serie y fecha de compra
conflicts.prohibit: Registros de propiedad personal, productos o servicios adquiridos, obtenidos o considerados u otros historiales o tendencias de adquisición o consumo.
conflicts.situation: A California resident reading the Spanish version buys a Subsplash product, and Subsplash records the product serial number and purchase date.
conflicts.reason: The Spanish CCPA table answers No for commercial information (purchase records), while the Spanish general section collects product purchase details. The English table answers Yes. Nothing indicates which governs.

conflicts.permit: les informations concernant les produits Subsplash que vous possédez, comme leurs numéros de série et leur date d’achat
conflicts.prohibit: Archives de biens personnels, de produits ou services achetés, obtenus ou envisagés, ou autres historiques d’achat ou de consommation ou tendances
conflicts.situation: A California resident reading the French version buys a Subsplash product, and Subsplash records the product serial number and purchase date.
conflicts.reason: The French CCPA table answers Non for commercial information (purchase records), while the French general section collects product purchase details. The English table answers Yes. Nothing indicates which governs.

conflicts.permit: Remarketing with Google Analytics, which enables us to provide relevant advertising on different websites and online services
conflicts.prohibit: Subsplash does not track its customers over time and across third party websites to provide targeted advertising and therefore does not respond to Do Not Track (DNT) signals.
conflicts.situation: A California customer visits the Subsplash site, and Subsplash uses Google Analytics remarketing to show that visitor relevant ads on other websites.
conflicts.reason: Remarketing follows site visitors onto other websites to serve targeted ads, which the Do Not Track disclosure denies. The disclosure states a company practice, and the remarketing statement has no regional or product limit.

conflicts.permit: Also, if we or our assets are acquired, or if we go out of business, enter bankruptcy, or go through some other change of control, Personal Information may be one of the assets transferred to or acquired by a third party.
conflicts.prohibit: Subsplash does not sell or rent your contact information to other marketers or any other third party.
conflicts.situation: Subsplash sells its assets to an acquirer, and customer contact information is transferred to the acquiring third party as one of the sold assets.
conflicts.reason: The no-sale statement covers any third party and states no business-transfer exception. The policy does not say whether an asset sale counts as selling contact information.
